schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Rock Creek Lake (Region 6, Inyo Co.) as a Put and Take water stocked with catchable-size (approx. 7-12 in) Rainbow Trout, release month range April-November. This is a provisional annual plan; CDFW's execution is not guaranteed.

This is a provisional annual plan; CDFW's execution is not guaranteed.
